literal: Xingzong, Part Three
idiomatic: Xingzong, Part Three

literal: In the sixteenth year, spring, first month, on jimao day, the court went to the Huntong River.
idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, on jimao day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.

literal: Second month, on gengshen day, went to Yuer Marsh.
idiomatic: On gengshen day of the second month the court went to Yuer Marsh.

literal: On xinyou day, forbidden officials at banquets and entertainments to present memorials on private affairs.
idiomatic: On xinyou day officials were forbidden at banquets and entertainments to present memorials on private affairs.

literal: Edict ordered that hereditary-selection offices employ the capable chosen from elders of each tribe.
idiomatic: An edict ordered that hereditary-selection offices employ the capable chosen from elders of each tribe.

literal: Third month, on dinghai day, went to Heishui Marsh.
idiomatic: On dinghai day of the third month the court went to Heishui Marsh.

literal: On guisi day, dispatched envoys to review and decide prisoners in Shuang Prefecture.
idiomatic: On guisi day envoys were dispatched to review and decide prisoners in Shuang Prefecture.

literal: On renyin day, heavy snow fell.
idiomatic: On renyin day heavy snow fell.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on yisi new moon, the Empress Dowager fell ill; the Emperor galloped to visit her.
idiomatic: On the yisi new moon of the fourth summer month the Empress Dowager fell ill, and the Emperor galloped to visit her.

literal: On bingwu day, the Empress Dowager recovered; the court again went to Heishui Marsh.
idiomatic: On bingwu day the Empress Dowager recovered, and the court again went to Heishui Marsh.

literal: On dingmao day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
idiomatic: On dingmao day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: Sixth month, on wushen day, summered at Yongan Mountain.
idiomatic: On wushen day of the sixth month the court summered at Yongan Mountain.

literal: On dingsi day, Zubu great king Tutugu came to court and presented local products.
idiomatic: On dingsi day Zubu great king Tutugu came to court and presented local products.

literal: On wuwu day, edict ordered commoners and gentry to submit memorials.
idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict ordered commoners and gentry to submit memorials.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinmao day, visited Qing Prefecture.
idiomatic: On xinmao day of the seventh autumn month the court visited Qing Prefecture.

literal: From this month until the ninth month, daily hunted at Chubu Gou Xialie, Xilun, Shita, and other mountains.
idiomatic: From this month until the ninth month the court hunted daily at Chubu Gou Xialie, Xilun, Shita, and other mountains.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on xinhai day, visited the Central Capital and paid respects at the ancestral temple.
idiomatic: On xinhai day of the tenth winter month the court visited the Central Capital and paid respects at the ancestral temple.

literal: On bingchen day, fixed the ritual for princesses performing daughter-in-law rites toward parents-in-law.
idiomatic: On bingchen day the ritual was fixed for princesses performing daughter-in-law rites toward parents-in-law.

literal: On gengwu day, Tieli Xianmen came to court; because this was his first tribute, he was promoted to Right Defender of the Gate Commandant grand general.
idiomatic: On gengwu day Tieli Xianmen came to court; because this was his first tribute, he was promoted to Right Defender of the Gate Commandant grand general.

literal: Eleventh month, on wuyin day, sacrificed at Muye Mountain.
idiomatic: On wuyin day of the eleventh month sacrifice was made at Muye Mountain.

literal: On jichou day, visited the Central Capital and attended upon the Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On jichou day the court visited the Central Capital and attended upon the Empress Dowager.

literal: On renchen day, forbidden leaking palace affairs.
idiomatic: On renchen day leaking palace affairs was forbidden.

literal: Twelfth month, on xinchou new moon, Jurchen dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the xinchou new moon of the twelfth month Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On xinhai day, paid respects at Taizu's temple and viewed the painting 《Taizong's Recovery of Jin》.
idiomatic: On xinhai day the court paid respects at Taizu's temple and viewed the painting 《Taizong's Recovery of Jin》.

literal: On guichou day, inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.
idiomatic: On guichou day the Emperor inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.

literal: On yimao day, because the Empress Dowager had recovered, mixed offenses of capital crime were reduced one degree in punishment, and those at convict labor and below were exempted.
idiomatic: On yimao day, because the Empress Dowager had recovered, mixed offenses of capital crime were reduced one degree in punishment, and those at convict labor and below were exempted.

literal: On gengshen day, Southern Court chancellor Du Fang and Han Shaorong erred in memorializing; each was punished with the great staff.
idiomatic: On gengshen day Southern Court chancellor Du Fang and Han Shaorong erred in memorializing, and each was punished with the great staff.

literal: Fang was dismissed and made military commissioner of Wuding Army.
idiomatic: Fang was dismissed and made military commissioner of Wuding Army.

literal: On renxu day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On renxu day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: In the seventeenth year, spring, first month, on dinghai day, went to spring waters.
idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, on dinghai day of the first spring month the court went to spring waters.

literal: Intercalary month, on guichou day, shot tigers at Houliji.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on guichou day, tigers were shot at Houliji.

literal: Second month, on xinsi day, relief given to the Yaowen and Chaowen tribes.
idiomatic: On xinsi day of the second month relief was given to the Yaowen and Chaowen tribes.

literal: That month, edict ordered commoners and gentry to speak on what benefited the state; they must not touch their own affairs; what slaves and maidservants saw, they might report to their masters but must not present it themselves.
idiomatic: That month an edict ordered commoners and gentry to speak on what benefited the state; they must not touch their own affairs; what slaves and maidservants saw, they might report to their masters but must not present it themselves.

literal: Xia State king Li Yuanhao died; his son Liangzuo dispatched envoys to announce it; the court immediately dispatched Yongxing Palace commissioner Yelü Li, Right Defender of the Guard grand guardian Yelü Xinglao, and Director of Works junior supervisor Wang Quan to offer condolences.
idiomatic: Xia State king Li Yuanhao died; his son Liangzuo sent envoys to announce it; the court immediately dispatched Yongxing Palace commissioner Yelü Li, Right Defender of the Guard grand guardian Yelü Xinglao, and Director of Works junior supervisor Wang Quan to offer condolences.

literal: Third month, on guimao day, made associate regent of Nanjing Xiao Taliege Left yilibi and Tanggu, who administered Right yilibi affairs, Right yilibi.
idiomatic: On guimao day of the third month associate regent of Nanjing Xiao Taliege was made Left yilibi and Tanggu, who administered Right yilibi affairs, was made Right yilibi.

literal: On bingwu day, Xia State Li Liangzuo dispatched envoys presenting his father Yuanhao's bequeathed goods.
idiomatic: On bingwu day Xia State Li Liangzuo sent envoys presenting his father Yuanhao's bequeathed goods.

literal: On dingmao day, Tiebudei State envoys came requesting to attack Xia State with their tribal army; not permitted.
idiomatic: On dingmao day Tiebudei State envoys came requesting to attack Xia State with their tribal army; permission was refused.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinwei day, Wuding Army military commissioner Du Fang again became Southern Court chancellor.
idiomatic: On xinwei day of the fourth summer month Wuding Army military commissioner Du Fang again became Southern Court chancellor.

literal: On bingzi day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingzi day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On jiashen day, Pulumaoduo tribe great king Pujian presented shipwrights.
idiomatic: On jiashen day Pulumaoduo tribe great king Pujian presented shipwrights.

literal: Sixth month, on gengchen day, Zubu presented twenty thousand horses and camels.
idiomatic: On gengchen day of the sixth month Zubu presented twenty thousand horses and camels.

literal: On xinmao day, Changbai Mountain grand preceptor Chaige and Huiba tribe grand preceptor Saladu came with tribute goods.
idiomatic: On xinmao day Changbai Mountain grand preceptor Chaige and Huiba tribe grand preceptor Saladu came with tribute goods.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on dingwei day, Boge, son of yuyue Momoyi, and Balu Eight Tribes' yilijin Hugu and others came to submit.
idiomatic: On dingwei day of the seventh autumn month Boge, son of yuyue Momoyi, and Balu Eight Tribes' yilijin Hugu and others came to submit.

literal: On jiayin day, reviewed prisoners and reduced mixed offenses of capital crime.
idiomatic: On jiayin day prisoners were reviewed and mixed offenses of capital crime were reduced.

literal: Eighth month, on bingxu day, again remitted rent and tax for Nanjing's poor households.
idiomatic: On bingxu day of the eighth month rent and tax for Nanjing's poor households was again remitted.

literal: On wuzi day, made Palace Front commander Yelü Yixian campaign army supreme commander, Zhongshun Army military commissioner Xia Xingmei deputy commander, and Northeastern detail-stable Yelü Muzhe army supervisor to attack Puniuli chieftain Taodeli.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Palace Front commander Yelü Yixian was made campaign army supreme commander, Zhongshun Army military commissioner Xia Xingmei deputy commander, and Northeastern detail-stable Yelü Muzhe army supervisor to attack Puniuli chieftain Taodeli.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiashen day, Southern Court great king Yelü Hanba died.
idiomatic: On jiashen day of the tenth winter month Southern Court great king Yelü Hanba died.

literal: On jiawu day, halted at Dulujin.
idiomatic: On jiawu day the court halted at Dulujin.

literal: Eleventh month, on yiwei new moon, dispatched envoys to register horses.
idiomatic: On the yiwei new moon of the eleventh month envoys were dispatched to register horses.

literal: On dingsi day, granted the Emperor's younger brother Chongyuan a gold tally.
idiomatic: On dingsi day the Emperor's younger brother Chongyuan was granted a gold tally.

literal: Enfeoffed imperial sons: Heluwo as Prince of Yue, Alian as Prince of Xu, Zhongshun Army military commissioner Xiejianu as Prince of Chen, Western Capital regent Tiebu as Prince of Han, tiyin Lüfen as Prince of Liaoxi, mobile palace deployment director Biegu as Prince of Liucheng, and Fengling Army military commissioner Hougu as Prince of Raole; Prince of Anding Nielugu was advanced to Prince of Chu.
idiomatic: Imperial sons were enfeoffed: Heluwo as Prince of Yue, Alian as Prince of Xu, Zhongshun Army military commissioner Xiejianu as Prince of Chen, Western Capital regent Tiebu as Prince of Han, tiyin Lüfen as Prince of Liaoxi, mobile palace deployment director Biegu as Prince of Liucheng, and Fengling Army military commissioner Hougu as Prince of Raole; Prince of Anding Nielugu was advanced to Prince of Chu.

literal: In the eighteenth year, spring, first month, on jiawu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, on the jiawu new moon of the first spring month there was a solar eclipse.

literal: On wuxu day, detained Xia State envoys congratulating the New Year without sending them back.
idiomatic: On wuxu day Xia State envoys congratulating the New Year were detained without being sent back.

literal: On jihai day, dispatched Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Weixin to inform Song of the campaign against Xia.
idiomatic: On jihai day Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Weixin was dispatched to inform Song of the campaign against Xia.

literal: On xinchou day, reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On xinchou day prisoners were reviewed.

literal: On bingwu day, went to Yuanyang Marsh.
idiomatic: On bingwu day the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.

literal: On bingchen day, hunted at Bate Mountain.
idiomatic: On bingchen day the court hunted at Bate Mountain.

literal: Yelü Yixian memorialized victory over Puniuli.
idiomatic: Yelü Yixian memorialized victory over Puniuli.

literal: Second month, on gengchen day, visited Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji's tent to inquire after his illness.
idiomatic: On gengchen day of the second month the court visited Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji's tent to inquire after his illness.

literal: On yiyou day, Yelü Yixian and others presented the captured Taodeli.
idiomatic: On yiyou day Yelü Yixian and others presented the captured Taodeli.

literal: Third month, on yisi day, Gaochang dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On yisi day of the third month Gaochang sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On renzi day, because Hongji's illness had recovered, amnesty for mixed offenses from capital crime downward.
idiomatic: On renzi day, because Hongji's illness had recovered, amnesty was granted for mixed offenses from capital crime downward.

literal: On dingsi day, Wugu dispatched envoys submitting allegiance.
idiomatic: On dingsi day Wugu sent envoys submitting allegiance.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on guiyou day, made Southern Court chancellor Yelü Gaoshi Nanjing supreme commander.
idiomatic: On guiyou day of the fourth summer month Southern Court chancellor Yelü Gaoshi was made Nanjing supreme commander.

literal: Fifth month, on jiachen day, chieftains of the Five States each led their tribes to submit.
idiomatic: On jiachen day of the fifth month chieftains of the Five States each led their tribes to submit.

literal: On gengxu day, Huiba tribal chief Wudietai Zha and others came to court.
idiomatic: On gengxu day Huiba tribal chief Wudietai Zha and others came to court.

literal: On wuwu day, Five States military commissioner Yelü Xiantong, for surrendering Wugu rebels, was appointed Left Defender of the Gate Commandant upper general.
idiomatic: On wuwu day Five States military commissioner Yelü Xiantong, for surrendering Wugu rebels, was appointed Left Defender of the Gate Commandant upper general.

literal: Sixth month, on renxu new moon, made Prince of Han Xiao Hui Henan Route campaign supreme commander, with Prince of Zhao Xiao Xiaoyou and Prince of Han Tiebu as deputies.
idiomatic: On the renxu new moon of the sixth month Prince of Han Xiao Hui was made Henan Route campaign supreme commander, with Prince of Zhao Xiao Xiaoyou and Prince of Han Tiebu as deputies.

literal: On chou day, reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On chou day prisoners were reviewed.

literal: On bingyin day, performed the ritual of the twelve spirit banners.
idiomatic: On bingyin day the ritual of the twelve spirit banners was performed.

literal: On jisi day, because Liao troops attacked Xia, Song dispatched Qian Yi with condolence gifts.
idiomatic: On jisi day, because Liao troops attacked Xia, Song sent Qian Yi with condolence gifts.

literal: On gengchen day, Zubu presented horses, camels, and precious curios.
idiomatic: On gengchen day Zubu presented horses, camels, and precious curios.

literal: On xinsi day, Xia State envoys came with tribute and were detained without being sent back.
idiomatic: On xinsi day Xia State envoys came with tribute and were detained without being sent back.

literal: On dinghai day, performed the rebirth ritual.
idiomatic: On dinghai day the rebirth ritual was performed.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuxu day, the Emperor personally campaigned.
idiomatic: On wuxu day of the seventh autumn month the Emperor personally campaigned.

literal: Eighth month, on xinyou new moon, crossed the river.
idiomatic: On the xinyou new moon of the eighth month the army crossed the river.

literal: Xia troops fled, and the army returned.
idiomatic: Xia troops fled, and the army returned.

literal: Ninth month, on dingwei day, Xiao Hui and others were defeated by Xia troops.
idiomatic: On dingwei day of the ninth month Xiao Hui and others were defeated by Xia troops.

literal: Winter, tenth month, Northern Route campaign supreme commander Yelü Dilugu led Zubu armies to Helan Mountain, captured Li Yuanhao's wife and his officials' families; when three thousand Xia troops came to fight, they were annihilated;
idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Northern Route campaign supreme commander Yelü Dilugu led Zubu armies to Helan Mountain, captured Li Yuanhao's wife and his officials' families; when three thousand Xia troops came to fight, they were annihilated;

literal: Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable Xiao Cishinu and Nankge Yelü Wol died in battle.
idiomatic: Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable Xiao Cishinu and Nankge Yelü Wol died in battle.

literal: Twelfth month, on wuyin day, trees at Qing Mausoleum caught fire.
idiomatic: On wuyin day of the twelfth month trees at Qing Mausoleum caught fire.

literal: On jimao day, reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On jimao day prisoners were reviewed.

literal: There was a case of a younger brother and a cousin elder brother who were bandits; both brothers were without sons, and the younger brother was specially pardoned.
idiomatic: There was a case of a younger brother and a cousin elder brother who were bandits; both brothers were without sons, and the younger brother was specially pardoned.

literal: In the nineteenth year, spring, first month, on gengyin day, monk Huijian was promoted acting Grand Master of Inspection.
idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, on gengyin day of the first spring month monk Huijian was promoted acting Grand Master of Inspection.

literal: On gengzi day, Yelü Dilugu was again enfeoffed Prince of Qishui; various generals and Zubu tribal chieftains each advanced in rank by degree.
idiomatic: On gengzi day Yelü Dilugu was again enfeoffed Prince of Qishui; various generals and Zubu tribal chieftains each advanced in rank by degree.

literal: Posthumously honored Xiao Cishinu as Associate Councilor of State.
idiomatic: Xiao Cishinu was posthumously honored as Associate Councilor of State.

literal: On xinchou day, dispatched envoys to demand accountability from Xia State.
idiomatic: On xinchou day envoys were dispatched to demand accountability from Xia State.

literal: On renyin day, went to Yuer Marsh.
idiomatic: On renyin day the court went to Yuer Marsh.

literal: Second month, on dinghai day, Xia generals Wapu, Wohe, and Yilingji attacked Jinsu City; Southern Court linya Yelü Gaojianu and others defeated them.
idiomatic: On dinghai day of the second month Xia generals Wapu, Wohe, and Yilingji attacked Jinsu City; Southern Court linya Yelü Gaojianu and others defeated them.

literal: Wapu was wounded and fled; Wohe and Yilingji were killed.
idiomatic: Wapu was wounded and fled; Wohe and Yilingji were killed.

literal: Third month, on wuxu day, Palace Front commander Xiao Dielide fought Xia at Sanjiao River and defeated them.
idiomatic: On wuxu day of the third month Palace Front commander Xiao Dielide fought Xia at Sanjiao River and defeated them.

literal: On guimao day, ordered Southwest pacification commissioner Xiao Punu, Northern Court great king Yixin, linya Xiao Samo, and others to lead troops against Xia, with mobile palace deployment director Biegu supervising the campaign.
idiomatic: On guimao day Southwest pacification commissioner Xiao Punu, Northern Court great king Yixin, linya Xiao Samo, and others were ordered to lead troops against Xia, with mobile palace deployment director Biegu supervising the campaign.

literal: On jiachen day, dispatched associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge to inspect troops at the border cities as a supporting force.
idiomatic: On jiachen day associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge was dispatched to inspect troops at the border cities as a supporting force.

literal: On jiyou day, halted at Xijidian.
idiomatic: On jiyou day the court halted at Xijidian.

literal: On bingchen day, visited Palace Front commander Xiao Dielide and imperial son-in-law Xiao Hudu's tents to inquire after their illnesses.
idiomatic: On bingchen day the court visited Palace Front commander Xiao Dielide and imperial son-in-law Xiao Hudu's tents to inquire after their illnesses.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingyin day, went to Yuer Marsh.
idiomatic: On bingyin day of the fourth summer month the court went to Yuer Marsh.

literal: On renshen day, Pulumaoduo tribe tiyin Xindu came with tribute.
idiomatic: On renshen day Pulumaoduo tribe tiyin Xindu came with tribute.

literal: On jiashen day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiashen day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Fifth month, on jichou day, went to Liang Pass.
idiomatic: On jichou day of the fifth month the court went to Liang Pass.

literal: On guisi day, Xiao Punu and others entered Xia territory, met no enemy, and returned after letting the army plunder freely.
idiomatic: On guisi day Xiao Punu and others entered Xia territory, met no enemy, and returned after letting the army plunder freely.
